A lightweight conversational AI interface powered by the Vercel AI SDK.

Ask questions, generate code, draft writing, or explore ideas — with fast streaming responses and a minimal UI.

**Stack**
- Next.js App Router
- Vercel AI SDK
- Streaming chat UI
- Deployed on Vercel
